title: SearchButton hover/focus/active + three-state theme control styling (AA contrast in both themes)
description: Baz 2026-10-04 (w-2026-10-04-dave-001): the FIND SearchButton hover previously fell back to a hard-coded light grey (`var(--sv-surface-hover, #f0f3f8)`) because `--sv-surface-hover` was never declared, which painted dark ink on a light grey in dark mode. The hover + focus-visible + active states now use `--sv-active` with the `--sv-control` border and the `--sv-focus` outline so the pair stays above WCAG AA in both themes (AC-205-9). The three-state theme control (`.rcf-theme`, `.rcf-theme-btn`) sits right of the SearchButton in `.tools`; `aria-pressed="true"` uses `--sv-button` / `--sv-onbutton`, hover and focus-visible use `--sv-active`, and the group is hidden under `html[data-embed="1"]`.
